what: A color plate is tilted −4° around its bottom-left corner and sits 7.5rem down and transparent, then when 15% of the plate enters the screen it stands up and rises in 1.1s cubic-bezier(.16,.84,.44,1) while opacity clears in 1s. When it leaves the screen it tilts and hides again, and stands up again each time it enters — a section where work plates slide diagonally up over a photo and overlap

options.--fx-rise: Starting distance pushed down (via style), default 7.5rem
options.--fx-dur · --fx-fade: Rise duration · fade-clear duration (via style), default 1.1s · 1s
options.once: With true, once it appears it doesn’t hide again (default: every time it comes in)

note: The original attaches and removes is-in with an IntersectionObserver (life-design creative .case-col). If a panel is taller than the viewport, its top is already well up before 15% is visible, so lower the threshold based on its length.

from.where: works.html .creative__case .case-col (yellow·sky·lime case panels — they overlap up 3.4375rem over the pinned main photo)
